startGameTip_zhangsanshuo.en:
Fellow Cultivators,
 After nearly two and a half years of development, Tale of Immortal has finally reached its official release, which marks a milestone for all of us, and we are glad to have you as our companions in the journey! We will continue to improve Tale of Immortal and add new content that is compatible with the current framework, so stay tuned!
 We have witnessed the adventure and breakthroughs of so many cultivators, and we, the developers from Guigu Studio, feel like we have achieved something seemingly impossible too. We would like to say thanks to you, as well as all fellow cultivators, for your support, encouragement, and advice that helped us all the way from our Early Access days to now. Thanks for buying our game!
 There are myriad ways toward an ideal, and ours is one of them. We hope our game will display to you a facet of the cultivation world, along with all of its myths and treasures.
 Before you start playing, there is another notice for your save files.
 Since the game has undergone many updates, it may not be able to load save files that are created under early versions, modified by game trainers or mods, or corrupted due to excessive force quits or Save/Load attempts. If you encountered the issue, you may:
 1. Replace the broken save file with backup save files exported before;
 2. Browse Discussions and Workshop for save file fix tools or consult players with similar issues;
 3. Start a new game;
 4. Send the broken save file to info@lightning.games, and we will try to fix it.
 Enjoy your adventure!
Sincerely,
Guigu Studio
startGameTip_zhangsanshuo.ch:
鬼谷工作室致道友：
	在经过将近两年半的开发之后，《鬼谷八荒》这趟修仙之旅在诸位道友的陪伴下，也到了一个新的里程碑。我们后续还会继续优化鬼谷八荒，并新增能被框架包含的新内容，敬请期待！
	这一路走来，是一个个存档角色的突破与修行，也是鬼谷工作室从零到一的突破，从无至有的修行。感谢此刻在屏幕前阅读这封致谢信的每一个你，是道友们的建议、鼓励及鞭策，支持着我们将游戏从抢鲜体验状态一步步完善至正式版。工作室在此，向购买了EA版本的所有玩家表示由衷的感谢。
	大道三千，遁去其一。心中有道者，无处不可悟，无处不可证。《鬼谷八荒》愿抛砖引玉，助道友们踏出这一步，不断追寻心目中理想的修仙世界——得一方天地，证本源本心。
	最后，在各位道友进入游戏前，我们有一则关于【存档】的提醒：
	由于游戏已经经过了多次版本更新，如果您是在游戏上架早期创建的存档，曾经使用过“修改器”、“Mod”等改变存档内容的工具，或曾在游戏运行过程中以强退、S/L等方法多次强行关闭过游戏，将可能会遇到正式版上线后，旧存档无法兼容的情况。如果出现这种情况，我们建议您做如下处理：
	1、如有曾经手动导出保存的存档副本，可以尝试替换导入；
	2、在留言板及创意工坊页面寻找相应工具，或与群友等交流，是否有类似情况曾经得到过解决；
	3、进行新档体验；
	4、将您的旧存档发送至info@lightning.games，工作室将尝试为您修复。
	传送阵法即将启动，预祝您的修行之旅圆满大成。
鬼谷工作室全体
敬上
